trello.name: Benchmark PgBouncer in transaction mode for dashboard workload
trello.desc: Raj to set up a load test mirroring the dashboard's query pattern and compare p95 latency with and without PgBouncer in transaction mode against the current Postgres connection setup. The dashboard is slow for accounts with lots of projects due to connection contention (not query cost). Bring benchmark numbers to the next product sync for review.

trello.name: Fix typo in onboarding email subject line
trello.desc: Tom to fix the typo in the onboarding email subject line ("recieve" should be "receive"), push the fix through the email template repo today, and get it re-approved.

trello.name: Update roadmap doc to reflect dark mode under September design-system upgrade
trello.desc: Tom to update the roadmap doc immediately after the meeting: move dark mode under the September design-system upgrade line (it currently shows dark mode under "Q3 committed"). This ensures sales stops promising dark mode as a standalone feature. Dark mode is not being built this cycle; it comes for free with the September design-system upgrade.
